title: Goals as an anchor: behaviours to watch
objectives: Explain why goals calm investors, including mental accounting used well.
Name five behaviours and the response to each.
body_md:
Why goals calm investors: a goal gives a time frame — a 20% fall matters much less when the money isn't needed for 12 years. A goal gives a yardstick — “Am I on track for my daughter's college?” replaces “Did I beat my neighbour's fund?” Mental accounting, used well: people treat labelled money differently. A folio named “Riya's college” is less likely to be raided for a phone upgrade than an unlabelled balance. Behaviours to watch: goal drift (using long-term goal money for short-term wants — keep goal folios labelled; agree in writing what each is for); present bias (delaying the start — show the cost of a 5-year delay in rupees); over-optimism (assuming 15–20% returns to make the SIP look small — use conservative, clearly labelled assumptions); panic near a goal (holding too much equity as the date approaches, then panicking in a fall — follow the glide path in good time); underestimating inflation (planning with today's cost — always show the future cost).

| Behaviour | What it looks like | How to respond |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Goal drift | Using long-term goal money for short-term wants | Keep goal folios labelled; agree in writing what each is for |
| Present bias | Delaying the start ("I'll begin next year") | Show the cost of a 5-year delay in rupees |
| Over-optimism | Assuming 15–20% returns to make the SIP look small | Use conservative, clearly labelled assumptions |
| Panic near a goal | Holding too much equity as the date approaches, then panicking in a fall | Follow the glide path in good time |
| Underestimating inflation | Planning with today's cost | Always show the future cost |

> **Talk-track:** “The market will fall many times before your daughter starts college. Our plan already expects that. What matters is that we stay on track for the date.”
example: “I'll begin next year”: show the cost of a 5-year delay in rupees — education SIP ₹13,300 becomes ₹28,300.
say: Judge investments by whether goals are on track, not by daily moves.
A goal gives a time frame and a yardstick.
never: Judge funds by daily market moves.
